# LLM token economics

> Case study and playbook: a production agent fleet went from 12.0 M to 1.0 M heartbeat tokens a day (-91%) with 18 methods in five groups.

Sanitised public showcase by Dr. Ravi Teja Thiriveedhi (clinician turned AI systems architect). Scope and limits: [TRUST.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/llm-token-economics/blob/main/TRUST.md).

## Docs

- [docs/methods.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/llm-token-economics/blob/main/docs/methods.md): The 18 methods: problem, change, measured effect
- [docs/case-study-heartbeat-diet.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/llm-token-economics/blob/main/docs/case-study-heartbeat-diet.md): The largest single win, step by step
- [docs/checklist.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/llm-token-economics/blob/main/docs/checklist.md): One-page audit for any agent system

## Demo

- [Heartbeat token calculator](https://sterilefield.github.io/llm-token-economics/): live demo on invented data
- [demo/heartbeat_model.py](https://github.com/sterilefield/llm-token-economics/blob/main/demo/heartbeat_model.py): runnable teaching model, standard library only
